subject: Business
instructions:
Strategy report: SWOT analysis of a local coffee chain.
Your report must:
- List at least two strengths
- List at least two weaknesses
- List at least two opportunities
- List at least two threats
- Recommend one strategic action based on the analysis
draft:
Strengths: The chain has a loyal customer base, and its stores sit next to three college campuses.
Weaknesses: It has no mobile ordering, and it depends on one roaster for all of its beans.
Opportunities: A new office park is opening nearby.
notes: One of two opportunities; threats and the recommendation absent. Four similar requirements test matching.
